deviations.what: The forward window is built as fy - 0:(forward_years - 1L), giving focal years fy, fy-1, fy-2 instead of the spec's fy-1, fy-2, fy-3, so a filing in year t enters F(t) (also breaking rule 6) and filings in year t+3 are dropped from F(t).
